ownership_decision.invariant: Every newly persisted message has its own UTC timestamp; a timestamp is never part of the model-provider message.

boundary_decision.interaction: The existing Creation Context public snapshot exposes an optional timestamp; the existing model adapter projects only role and content.
prohibited_dependencies: No new Creation-to-provider field or cross-context dependency.
No parallel message-timestamp collection indexed by message position.

domain_forces: Creation owns its checkpoints and the public snapshot.
The model provider must not receive UI-only metadata.
Legacy serialized snapshots omit the new field.
implementation_design.decision: No tactical pattern: one Creation message value carries an optional creation time, and one owner-local append operation creates both facts together.
invariants_preserved: New messages are timestamped together with their content and role.
The model wire representation remains role plus content only.
Legacy messages remain valid to present.
rejected_alternatives: A parallel timestamp array can silently drift from its message index.
Adding a timestamp to the provider request changes model context and cost for a UI concern.
implementation_design.counterfactual_check: Remove timestamp assignment from the owner-local append operation; the focused Creation test must fail, then restoration must pass.
